/* Remove QComboBox::drop-down overrides to restore native/classic OS arrows that might have been hidden */

/* QSpinBox/QDoubleSpinBox lose their native up/down buttons once a custom
   border/background is applied above, so they must be redrawn explicitly
   as classic 3D-beveled stepper buttons with visible triangle arrows. */
QSpinBox, QDoubleSpinBox {
    padding-right: 2px;
}
QSpinBox::up-button, QDoubleSpinBox::up-button {
    subcontrol-origin: border;
    subcontrol-position: top right;
    width: 15px;
    height: 10px;
    background-color: #D4D0C8;
    border: 1px outset #FFFFFF;
    border-right: none;
    border-top: none;
}
QSpinBox::down-button, QDoubleSpinBox::down-button {
    subcontrol-origin: border;
    subcontrol-position: bottom right;
    width: 15px;
    height: 10px;
    background-color: #D4D0C8;
    border: 1px outset #FFFFFF;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: none;
}
QSpinBox::up-button:pressed, QDoubleSpinBox::up-button:pressed,
QSpinBox::down-button:pressed, QDoubleSpinBox::down-button:pressed {
    background-color: #A0A0A0;
}
QSpinBox::up-button:disabled, QDoubleSpinBox::up-button:disabled,
QSpinBox::down-button:disabled, QDoubleSpinBox::down-button:disabled {
    background-color: #C0C0C0;
}
QSpinBox::up-arrow, QDoubleSpinBox::up-arrow {
    image: url(D:/BroniszLabs/EPW_Platform/EPW-OS/epw_os/tests/fixtures/assets/spin_up.png);
    width: 9px;
    height: 5px;
}
QSpinBox::down-arrow, QDoubleSpinBox::down-arrow {
    image: url(D:/BroniszLabs/EPW_Platform/EPW-OS/epw_os/tests/fixtures/assets/spin_down.png);
    width: 9px;
    height: 5px;
}
QSpinBox::up-arrow:disabled, QDoubleSpinBox::up-arrow:disabled {
    image: url(D:/BroniszLabs/EPW_Platform/EPW-OS/epw_os/tests/fixtures/assets/spin_up_disabled.png);
}
QSpinBox::down-arrow:disabled, QDoubleSpinBox::down-arrow:disabled {
    image: url(D:/BroniszLabs/EPW_Platform/EPW-OS/epw_os/tests/fixtures/assets/spin_down_disabled.png);
}
